summary: Two demonstrated defects: positive nonunit slopes are excluded, and recognizable answer banks reveal the correct choice without reading the integrand. Mathematics, grading, rendering, and packaging checks pass. Package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Integrate n/(ax+b) using linear substitution and select (n/a) ln|ax+b|+C.
reasoning_steps: Retain the numerator and integrate the reciprocal.
Substitute back and distinguish coefficient, sign, and argument distractors.
invariants: One indefinite integral with constant numerator and nonzero affine slope.
Logarithmic antiderivative with absolute value and additive constant.
Five radio choices with exactly one correct answer.
permitted_variations: Small numerator, slope, and intercept changes preserving the substitution method.
Positive, negative, integral, and fractional correct coefficients.
Prompt wording, denominator order, distractors, and choice position.
source_refs: 539b2d2a-d59d-59a2-8b1b-cd7fbe582c04: Introduction derives substitution and checks by differentiation.

source_replay.details: Five complete supported source questions reproduce exact prompts, solutions, complete unordered banks, and keys. The excluded positive-slope family is addressed separately as a restriction.

math.details: 83 records independently checked from mathematical text: exactly one derivative-matching choice and a correct final solution.

variety.details: Every positive slope is fixed to 1. Canonical positive nonunit-slope cases are rejected, and coefficient rank/form remains answer-bearing within recognizable banks.

scope.details: Observed variations preserve the easy, single-substitution workload and radio response contract.

grading.details: Native grader accepted 23 independently correct selections and rejected 92 distractors. Free-entry equivalence is inapplicable to these radio fields.

rendering.details: Eleven actual-UI previews passed automated checks; seven screenshots were inspected across profiles and controlled pairs. UI shuffling rules out a fixed first-position defect.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions match. Relocation and deterministic replay reproduce the runner batch; duplicate rejection was exercised. Declared package files are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: After delivery filtering, bank-only strategies succeed on 19/19 coefficient cases and 14/14 negative-slope cases. The exact batch retains corresponding 2/2 and 1/1 successes. Controlled dependencies pass, but do not eliminate these shortcuts. Captured inventory contains no generated historical records.

findings.description: allowed() fixes every positive slope to 1, excluding the complete canonical example 3/(5x+2), the Introduction's 1/(2x+1), and q-49511's 2/(3x+5). Missing fields on q-49511 do not justify excluding the operation supported by the complete lesson.

findings.requested_change: Extend parameter and bank construction to support small positive nonunit slopes and numerator scaling. Derive dependent content from n/a, retain source banks, and document q-49511's inferred key and solution separately from captured evidence.

findings.description: Coefficient banks always make the largest positive coefficient correct; negative-slope banks always make the unique negative proper fraction correct. Both strategies ignore the integrand and survive publication filtering and UI shuffling.
